decisions.choice: Use Coop's existing feature-pack structure instead of a cross-repo mega-plan
decisions.rationale: Coop already treats .plans/features plus status.json as execution truth.

decisions.choice: Keep API and contracts out of scope for week one
decisions.rationale: The first slice is operating-system proof, not runtime behavior.

decisions.choice: Use the existing agent-control-plane and judgment-cues work as local precedents
decisions.rationale: The new workflow should compound existing run-ledger and human-judgment patterns instead of creating a second review system.

decisions.choice: Treat the scaffold-hardening pass as the first completed measured lane
decisions.rationale: The hub now has real ledger, scorecard, adversarial review, closeout, and rule-feedback evidence without pretending week-six adoption is complete.
